driver_legal_tips_body:
Welcome to Tashila, your platform to get new transport opportunities and organize your services. To ensure a successful experience for you and the clients, please follow these tips:

1. Keep your profile updated: Always ensure the accuracy of your name, phone, profile photo, truck information, and required documents.

2. Set status to ONLINE when ready: 🟢 Toggle Online to receive trip requests, and ⚪ Offline when unavailable.

3. Respond to requests quickly: Review trip details, location, and required truck type as soon as a request arrives.

4. Confirm your ability to execute a trip before accepting: Verify locations, distance, and estimated fare. Fulfilling accepted trips improves your ratings.

5. Be punctual: Arrive at the agreed time and inform the client of any delays to build trust and receive better ratings.

6. Handle clients professionally: Communicate respectfully, safeguard client property, and provide high service quality.

7. Maintain your truck: Ensure vehicle readiness, cleanliness, and safety compliance before starting your work.

8. Adhere to transport and safety laws: Do not transport hazardous/prohibited materials, respect traffic rules, and never exceed weight limits.

9. Update trip status inside the app: 📍 Arrived at pickup 🚚 Started transit ✅ Completed trip.

10. Monitor your earnings and ratings: Maintain a high average rating to gain more opportunities.

11. Do not cancel accepted trips unless absolutely necessary: Frequent cancellations negatively impact your profile and client trust.

12. Contact support whenever needed.
driver_legal_terms_body:
Terms of Use

Welcome to Tashila. Tashila is a digital platform designed to facilitate communication and connection between individuals who need local transport services and pickup truck owners available to provide this service. By using Tashila, you agree to be bound by the following Terms of Use.

1. Service Definition
Tashila is an intermediary platform that:
• Connects clients with registered drivers on the platform.
• Facilitates sending and receiving transport requests.
• Provides tools to organize communication and manage trips.
Tashila is not a transport company and does not own the trucks used; it only provides a platform to connect the two parties.

2. Account Creation
To use the app, the user must:
• Provide true and accurate information.
• Use a valid personal phone number.
• Maintain credentials confidentiality.
• Not use another person's account.
Tashila reserves the right to suspend or delete any account containing incorrect information or using the app in violation.

3. Driver Registration Terms
The driver must:
• Own an appropriate and legal vehicle for transport services.
• Provide correct vehicle information.
• Submit required documents for verification.
• Comply with applicable traffic laws.
Tashila reserves the right to review and accept or reject any driver's account.

4. Driver Responsibilities
The driver is responsible for:
• Vehicle safety.
• Respecting traffic laws.
• Preserving client property during transit.
• Acting respectfully and professionally with clients.
• Executing accepted trips.
Tashila is not responsible for damages resulting from driver conduct or vehicle condition.

5. Client Responsibilities
The client agrees to:
• Provide correct pickup and destination details.
• Describe transport items accurately.
• Not request transport of prohibited or illegal items.
• Respect the driver during service delivery.

6. Pricing and Payment
Pricing is set according to platform settings and approved factors.
Payments are currently made in cash directly between the client and driver.
Tashila may introduce other payment methods in the future.

7. Trip Cancellation
The client or driver can cancel a request before service begins.
Action may be taken against accounts that cancel repeatedly to the detriment of the service.

8. Ratings and Reviews
Users can rate their service experience. Publishing false reviews, using offensive language, or attempting to influence other users' ratings is prohibited.

9. Prohibited Use
The app must not be used for:
• Any illegal activity.
• Providing falsified information.
• Attempting to hack or disrupt the system.
• Unauthorized advertising.
• Creating fake accounts.

10. Data and Privacy
Tashila collects necessary information to provide the service, such as: Name, phone number, profile photo, driver vehicle details, and location during service delivery. This data is used to operate the app, improve service, and protect users. Data will not be sold to third parties.

11. Limitation of Liability
Tashila acts as a technical connection platform. It is not responsible for service quality provided by the driver, delays due to circumstances beyond control, damages to cargo, or agreements made outside the app.

12. Account Suspension
Tashila may suspend or delete an account for violating terms of use, providing incorrect information, platform abuse, or repeated verified complaints.

13. Amendment of Terms
Tashila reserves the right to modify these terms. Users will be notified of significant changes via the app.

14. Support & Contact
For questions or issues, contact support via:
• Phone: +213791453050
• Email: tashilaapp@gmail.com

15. Acceptance of Terms
By using the Tashila app and creating an account, the user acknowledges that they have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms of Use.
driver_legal_privacy_body:
Privacy Policy

We attach great importance to the privacy of our users and are committed to protecting the personal information collected during the use of the app. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect user data when using Tashila. By using the app, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

1. Who We Are
Tashila is a digital platform connecting local transport clients with registered pickup truck owners within serviced areas.

2. Information We Collect
a) Clients: Full name, phone, optional avatar, language, trip history, ratings.
b) Drivers: Name, phone, photo, truck details (type, specs, registration documents), completed trips, earnings, ratings.
c) Location: Real-time GPS for matching, route guidance, and fare calculations.

3. How We Use Information
To provide the service (account setup, client matching, trip updates, notifications), improve the app (usage analytics, performance, debugging), and maintain safety (identity checks, fraud prevention).

4. Information Sharing
Necessary trip data is shared between client and driver (name, phone if needed, locations) and with platform support. We never sell or rent your personal data.

5. Third-Party Services
The app integrates maps, SMS providers, push notifications, storage, and database services subject to their own policies.

6. Data Protection
We employ secure connections and access control measures. No digital storage or transfer is 100% secure; absolute protection cannot be guaranteed.

7. Data Retention
We retain data as long as necessary to run the account, deliver services, or comply with legal requirements.

8. Account Deletion
Users can request account deletion via the settings menu. Stored data is removed or anonymized except where required by law.

9. User Rights
You have the right to review collected details, update credentials, request deletion, or contact support about data usage.

10. Children's Privacy
The platform is not intended for children under the legal age.

11. Updates to this Policy
We may update this policy periodically. The updated version will be posted directly in the app.

12. Contact Us
Email: tashilaapp@gmail.com, Phone: +213791453050
